text.en:
Section 1 is hereby amended as follows:
"Sec. 1. Any provision of existing law, executive or administrative order, or rule or regulation to the contrary
notwithstanding, the importation, free from customs duties, or kerosene, diesels, liquified petroleum gas, fuel
oil, aviation-turbo fuel, aviation gas, and other processed products as may be determined by the President
upon certification of the Philippine National Oil Industry Commission shall be allowed until 30 June 1974
unless sooner terminated by the President."

This decree shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 19th day of March, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-four.
